# How to translate this chunk

This file holds `items`, a list of `{"k", "ctx", "t"}`. `t` is English text
that a reader of an Indian app or website sees. `ctx` is the field it came
from, such as label, hint, button, documents, brief or title. Use it to judge
tone and length: a label stays short, a hint can be a sentence.

Write `{"items": [{"k": ..., "t": ...}, ...]}` to the path in `write_to`.
Keep every `k` unchanged and in the same order. Put the translation in `t`.
Leave out `ctx`. Do not add, merge, split or drop items.

## Keep these exactly as they are

- Placeholders and markup: `{0}`, `{name}`, `%s`, `%d`, `%1$s`, HTML tags, `\n`.
- Website addresses, e-mail addresses and links.
- Every number: phone and toll-free numbers, Aadhaar, account, IFSC, PAN, PIN
  codes, amounts, dates, percentages. Write digits as 0-9, the Western digits,
  in every language, including Urdu. People type these into forms that take
  Western digits.
- Acronyms people know in Latin letters: OTP, PAN, IFSC, UPI, KYC, e-KYC, DBT,
  BPL, APL, NFSA, PM-KISAN, SMS, PDF, ID.

## Names

- Product, app, portal and scheme names: transliterate them into the script so
  they read naturally. Keep any acronym inside them in Latin, so "APPSC
  portal" becomes APPSC followed by the word for portal.
- A button or menu label quoted from a website, such as 'Apply Online' or
  'Register', stays in English inside quotes. The reader has to find that exact
  English word on the screen.
- People and places in examples are transliterated, never replaced with other
  names.
- Government office titles are transliterated so the reader can say them at
  the counter: Tahsildar, Patwari, Talathi, Mamlatdar, BDO, Collector, Gram
  Panchayat. The language notes below give the usual local forms.

## Tone

Write for an ordinary person who may be elderly and may have had little
schooling. Use everyday spoken language, not heavy official vocabulary. Where
people really say the English word, write it in the script: online, form,
portal, login, mobile, bank, certificate, download, upload, app. Keep
instructions short and direct, in the form "do this".

"Gender" means sex (male or female). It is never the word for caste.

## Before you write

Check that you have the same number of items as the input and that every
number and placeholder came through. Write the whole file in ONE Write call,
as valid UTF-8 JSON with no `\u` escapes and nothing else in the file.

## Hindi (hi)

Script: Devanagari. Used in UP, MP, Bihar, Rajasthan, Haryana, HP, Uttarakhand,
Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh and Delhi, and understood across the north.
Tone: everyday spoken Hindi (Hindustani). Avoid Sanskritised official words.
Words: ऑनलाइन, फॉर्म, पोर्टल, लॉगिन, आधार, बैंक, मोबाइल, OTP, हेल्पलाइन,
सर्टिफिकेट, डाउनलोड, अपलोड.
UI: आवेदन करें (Apply), जमा करें (Submit), आगे (Next), पीछे (Back), खोजें (Search),
शेयर करें (Share), सेटिंग (Settings), भाषा (Language), मदद (Help).
Offices: तहसीलदार, पटवारी, ग्राम पंचायत, कलेक्टर, ब्लॉक विकास कार्यालय (BDO).
Gender: लिंग (never जाति). Money: रु. 6,000; रु. 8 लाख. September: सितंबर.

## Gujarati (gu)

Script: Gujarati. Used in Gujarat, and spoken in Dadra & Nagar Haveli and
Daman & Diu.
Tone: everyday spoken Gujarati.
Words: ઓનલાઇન, ફોર્મ, પોર્ટલ, લૉગિન, આધાર, બેંક, મોબાઇલ, OTP, હેલ્પલાઇન, સર્ટિફિકેટ / દાખલો,
ડાઉનલોડ, અપલોડ.
UI: અરજી કરો, સબમિટ કરો, આગળ, પાછળ, શોધો, શેર કરો, સેટિંગ્સ, ભાષા, મદદ.
Offices: મામલતદાર, તલાટી, ગ્રામ પંચાયત, કલેક્ટર, તાલુકા પંચાયત.
Gender: જાતિ is caste; use લિંગ. Money: રૂ. 6,000; રૂ. 8 લાખ. September: સપ્ટેમ્બર.

## Marathi (mr)

Script: Devanagari. Used in Maharashtra, and widely in Goa.
Tone: everyday Marathi as spoken in Maharashtra.
Words: ऑनलाइन, फॉर्म, पोर्टल, लॉगिन, आधार, बँक, मोबाइल, OTP, हेल्पलाइन, दाखला / सर्टिफिकेट,
डाउनलोड, अपलोड.
UI: अर्ज करा, सबमिट करा, पुढे, मागे, शोधा, शेअर करा, सेटिंग्ज, भाषा, मदत.
Offices: तहसीलदार, तलाठी, ग्रामपंचायत, जिल्हाधिकारी (कलेक्टर), आपले सरकार सेवा केंद्र.
Gender: लिंग. Money: रु. 6,000; रु. 8 लाख. September: सप्टेंबर.

## Bengali (bn)

Script: Bengali. Used in West Bengal and Tripura, and in Assam's Barak Valley
and the Andamans.
Tone: everyday spoken Bengali (চলিত ভাষা), not সাধু ভাষা.
Words: অনলাইন, ফর্ম, পোর্টাল, লগইন, আধার, ব্যাংক, মোবাইল, OTP, হেল্পলাইন, সার্টিফিকেট,
ডাউনলোড, আপলোড.
UI: আবেদন করুন, জমা দিন, পরবর্তী, পিছনে, খুঁজুন, শেয়ার করুন, সেটিংস, ভাষা, সাহায্য.
Offices: বিডিও অফিস, গ্রাম পঞ্চায়েত, তহসিলদার, জেলাশাসক (কালেক্টর), দুয়ারে সরকার.
Gender: লিঙ্গ. Money: 6,000 টাকা; 8 লাখ টাকা. September: সেপ্টেম্বর.

## Assamese (as)

Script: Bengali script with the Assamese letters ৰ and ৱ. Used in Assam.
This is Assamese, not Bengali. Use Assamese words and spellings: আঁচনি
(scheme), বেংক (bank), কৰক (do), নহয় (is not).
Words: অনলাইন, প্ৰপত্ৰ / ফৰ্ম, পৰ্টেল, লগইন, আধাৰ, বেংক, মবাইল, OTP, হেল্পলাইন, প্ৰমাণপত্ৰ,
ডাউনল'ড, আপল'ড.
UI: আবেদন কৰক, দাখিল কৰক, পৰৱৰ্তী, উভতি যাওক, বিচাৰক, শ্বেয়াৰ কৰক, ছেটিংছ, ভাষা, সহায়.
Offices: চক্ৰ বিষয়াৰ কাৰ্যালয় (Circle Office), গাঁও পঞ্চায়ত, উন্নয়ন খণ্ড কাৰ্যালয় (BDO),
জিলা উপায়ুক্ত.
Gender: লিংগ. Money: 6,000 টকা; 8 লাখ টকা. September: ছেপ্তেম্বৰ.

items.t: Upload the girl's photo and the documents for that stage, then submit. Write down the application number.
The block office (villages) or the tehsil (towns) checks the form, and the District Probation Officer's office approves it. You can see the status after you log in.
After approval the money is paid through PFMS into the mother's account. Check the bank passbook or SMS.

When the girl reaches the next stage, log in again with the same ID and apply for that stage in the same school year. Do not make a new registration for the same girl, or every application for her gets rejected.
181 (Mahila Helpline, UP Women Welfare) / 1076 (CM Helpline); District Probation Officer's office in your district
Mukhyamantri Samuhik Vivah Yojana (Samuhik Vivah)
Social Welfare Department (Samaj Kalyan Vibhag), Government of Uttar Pradesh

The UP government spends Rs.1 lakh on each couple married at a mass wedding it organises. Rs.64,000 goes into the bride's bank account, Rs.21,000 is given as household gifts and Rs.15,000 pays for the ceremony. The total was earlier Rs.51,000. It is for brides from poor families of every religion with income up to Rs.3 lakh a year, and also for widowed, abandoned or legally divorced women who are remarrying. The bride applies online with her Aadhaar, and the wedding is held at a block, town or district mass wedding run by the District Social Welfare Officer.
Rs.1,00,000 per couple: Rs.64,000 to the bride's account, Rs.21,000 in gifts, Rs.15,000 for the ceremony
The bride's parents or guardians are permanent residents of Uttar Pradesh. The bride herself must be an adult and applies herself
The family is poor or needy, with income up to Rs.3 lakh a year
On the wedding date the bride is at least 18 and the groom at least 21
The bride is unmarried, or is a widow, an abandoned woman or a legally divorced woman who is remarrying
SC, ST and OBC applicants must give a caste certificate. Orphan girls, daughters of widows or disabled parents, and girls with a disability get priority
She must not take marriage money from any other central or state scheme for this wedding
Aadhaar card of the bride and the groom
Age proof of both: school record, birth certificate, voter ID, MGNREGA job card or Aadhaar
Income certificate (family income up to Rs.3 lakh a year)
Bride's bank passbook, for an account in her own name linked to Aadhaar
Recent photos of the bride and the groom
For remarriage: the former husband's death certificate or the court's divorce decree
Choose Aadhaar. Use the 16-digit VID or a driving licence only if you cannot use the Aadhaar number.
The bride's own Aadhaar, not her father's. The form is filled in the bride's name.
A number the family keeps. The OTP and every SMS about the form, the wedding date and the payment come here.
You confirm that no other government scheme is giving marriage money for this wedding. If this is found false, the money is recovered.
Write both exactly as on Aadhaar.
She must be 18 or older on the wedding date. Upload the age proof that shows this date.
Choose your block if you live in a village, or your nagar panchayat, nagar palika or nagar nigam if you live in a town.
Write the figure from the income certificate. It must be Rs.3 lakh or less.
Groom's name / Aadhaar / date of birth
The groom must be 21 or older on the wedding date. His Aadhaar is checked again at the venue.
An account in the bride's own name, linked to her Aadhaar. The Rs.64,000 is paid only into this account.
Open cmsvy.upsdc.gov.in and tap Apply (आवेदन करें), then the link to fill the application. Choose Aadhaar, enter the bride's Aadhaar number and mobile, tick the declaration and tap Verify.
Fill in the bride's, family's, groom's and bank details, upload the photos and certificates, and submit. Write down the form number.

The block verifier (villages) or the urban body verifier (towns) checks the details, and the District Social Welfare Officer approves the form. The status comes by SMS. You can correct a form only after an SMS asks you to.
An SMS gives the date and venue of the mass wedding. The bride and groom go there with their Aadhaar cards, are checked at the venue and are married by their own rites.
The gifts are handed over at the venue. Rs.64,000 is transferred to the bride's bank account after the wedding.
Print the marriage certificate from the portal (Print Marriage Certificate) and keep it for the marriage registration and other records.
0522-2209259 (Samuhik Vivah helpline) / 0522-3538700 (Social Welfare Directorate, Lucknow) / 1076 (CM Helpline)
Atal Ayushman Uttarakhand Yojana (Ayushman Golden Card)
State Health Authority, Uttarakhand (Medical Health & Family Welfare Department)

Free, cashless hospital treatment up to Rs 5 lakh a year per family for almost every family in Uttarakhand. Families on the central PM-JAY list are covered by PM-JAY, and the state covers all the other resident families under Atal Ayushman on the same terms, hospitals and packages. The Ayushman (golden) card is made from your ration card or family register, on the phone or at a Jan Seva Kendra (CSC).
Uttarakhand families found in any of these lists: NFSA ration card data, the old Mukhyamantri Swasthya Bima Yojana, SECC 2011 or SECC Plus
No income limit and no limit on family size; every member is covered
Not for people covered by CGHS, ECHS, ESIC or the State Government Health Scheme (state employees and pensioners have their own SGHS card)
Illnesses you already have are covered from day one
Atal Ayushman uses a referral system, so planned treatment at a private hospital may first need a referral from a government hospital
Family ID: ration card (new or old) or a copy of the family register (Parivar Register)
If you have neither: an ID such as voter ID, birth certificate, permanent residence certificate, PAN or passport showing your father's, mother's or spouse's name
Any working number you hold. The OTP and approval message come here.
Pick Uttarakhand. Atal Ayushman families are on the same Ayushman system, so the search works for both.
The ration card number brings up the whole family. You can also search by Aadhaar.
Copy it from your ration card. If your family is not found, try Aadhaar or go to a Jan Seva Kendra.
Aadhaar of the member whose card you are making. Each member is done separately.
Good for elderly people whose fingerprints do not scan. Use Aadhaar OTP if the mobile is linked to Aadhaar.
Relation to the person named first on the ration card.
Choose Uttarakhand and search your family by ration card number or Aadhaar.
Pick the member, verify with Aadhaar OTP or face authentication, take the live photo, fill the details and submit.
The State Health Authority approves it, usually within a day or two. Log in again and download the card.
If your name is not found or e-KYC fails, take Aadhaar and the ration card or family register to a Jan Seva Kendra (CSC) or the Arogya Mitra desk of an empanelled hospital.
When you need treatment, get a government hospital referral where required, then show the card at the Arogya Mitra desk. Treatment is cashless.
155368 / 1800-180-5368 (State Health Authority, Uttarakhand) / 14555 (Ayushman Bharat national helpline)
Uttarakhand Old Age Pension (Vridhavastha Pension)

Rs 1,500 a month for people aged 60 and above in Uttarakhand who are BPL or whose monthly income is up to Rs 4,000. Husband and wife can both get it if each qualifies. You apply online on the Social Welfare Department's pension portal (eSPAN), and the money is paid into your bank account every three months. About 6 lakh elderly people get it now.
Rs 1,500 a month, paid every 3 months (June, September, December, March)
Aged 60 or above and living in Uttarakhand
From a BPL family, or with monthly income up to Rs 4,000 on a Tehsildar's income certificate
Husband and wife can both receive it if each qualifies
Not getting any other central or state government pension
Bank account in your own name (not a joint or loan account), linked to Aadhaar
BPL certificate, or income certificate from the Tehsildar (monthly income not above Rs 4,000)
Resolution of the Gram Sabha open meeting (in villages)
Copy of the family register (Parivar Register)
Voter ID (its number is asked in the form)
Social Security State Portal (eSPAN), Social Welfare Department Uttarakhand
Choose the old age pension from the list. The scheme cannot be changed after saving.
Type in English; the portal writes the Hindi itself. It must match Aadhaar and the bank passbook.
Category, date of birth and age
Your age must be 60 or more.
Your login ID and password come here by SMS. Give the number linked to Aadhaar.
How many years you have lived in the state.
Both are required. Tick the box allowing the department to use Aadhaar for the pension.
District, area type, tehsil, block, panchayat, village
Pauri Garhwal / Rural / Kotdwar / Dugadda / Sendhikhal / Sendhikhal
Fill carefully. These cannot be corrected by you later.
Enter each twice. Use your own account linked to Aadhaar, not a joint or loan account.
BPL ID or income certificate number, date and monthly income

Your applicant login ID and password come by SMS. Log in through Applicant Login.

The verifying officers check it and the District Social Welfare Office sanctions it. Follow it under Application Status on the portal.

1800-180-4236 (toll-free) / 6395221188 (WhatsApp and mobile) / 0135-2669764 (IT cell, Social Welfare Department)
Nanda Gaura Yojana (Rs 11,000 at Birth + Rs 51,000 after Class 12)
Women Empowerment and Child Development Department, Uttarakhand

Money for daughters of low-income families in Uttarakhand, in two parts: Rs 11,000 when a girl is born in a hospital, and Rs 51,000 when she passes Class 12, joins a degree or diploma course and is unmarried. Up to two living daughters per family can benefit. You apply online on the Nanda Gaura portal, within 6 months of the birth, and by 30 November of the year she passes Class 12. Money is given first come, first served within the yearly budget.
Rs 11,000 at birth + Rs 51,000 after Class 12 (Rs 62,000 per daughter)
Parents are permanent residents of Uttarakhand
Family income up to Rs 6,000 a month (Rs 72,000 a year), on a Tehsildar's income certificate not older than 1 year
Only two living daughters of a family can get it
Birth stage: born in a hospital or ANM centre, mother registered at the Anganwadi during pregnancy, and the application made within 6 months of birth

Class 12 stage: passed Class 12 from a recognised board or NIOS, admitted to a degree or at least a 1-year diploma, unmarried, name on the family ration card; apply by 30 November of the year she passes
Aadhaar and PAN card of mother and father (and of the girl for the Class 12 stage); a PAN application receipt is accepted
Income certificate issued by the Tehsildar
Birth certificate and institutional delivery certificate (birth stage)
Anganwadi worker's certificate and MCP (vaccination) card (birth stage)
Class 10 and Class 12 certificates, the principal's certificate and proof of college admission (Class 12 stage)
Ration card copy and family register copy (or a certificate from the councillor)

Bank passbook (joint account of mother and girl for birth, the girl's own for Class 12; Aadhaar-linked, not a Jan Dhan account), with last year's statements of family accounts and the last 3 electricity bills
The OTP comes here, and this number becomes your login ID.
Choose the district where the family lives.
Type the code to verify the number before the registration form opens.
Write the daughter's name as on her birth certificate or school records.
Write it down safely. You log in with the mobile number and this password.
The girl's Aadhaar. For a newborn without Aadhaar, the mother's Aadhaar can be entered.
The child development project (block) of your area.
Choose the birth stage within 6 months of birth, or the Class 12 stage after she passes and joins college.
As written on the Tehsildar's income certificate. It must not be above Rs 6,000 a month.
Joint account of mother and girl (or the mother's) for birth; the girl's own account for Class 12. Not a Jan Dhan account.
Open nandagaurauk.in, click the new applicant registration link, enter your mobile number and district, and verify with the OTP.
Fill the girl's name, password, Aadhaar and block to register, then log in with the mobile number and password.
Fill the application for the right stage and upload every certificate clearly, each under 200 KB. Submit and note the application number.
The Child Development Project Officer checks the papers, and the district committee chaired by the Chief Development Officer approves eligible cases.
The money is sent by DBT: Rs 11,000 to the joint or mother's account, or Rs 51,000 to the girl's account. If the year's budget runs out, approved girls are paid first the next year.
92595 53906 (scheme helpline) / 76681 51041 (technical helpline) / 0135-2775813 (WECD Directorate, Dehradun)
Department of Women & Child Development and Social Welfare, West Bengal

Money for girls who stay in school and stay unmarried. A girl aged 13 to 18 in Class VIII or above gets a yearly grant (K1), and at 18, if she is still studying and unmarried, a one-time grant (K2), both paid into her own bank account. The scheme was called Kanyashree Prakalpa until 14 August 2026, when the state renamed it Kanyaratna and announced that the yearly grant will double to Rs.2,000 from the 2027 school year and the one-time grant will rise to Rs.50,000; the website, forms and application IDs still say Kanyashree. Girls apply through their school or college, not on their own.
Rs.1,000 a year (Rs.2,000 from 2027) + one-time Rs.25,000 at 18 (Rs.50,000 announced)
181 (Women Helpline, also for schoolgirls under Kanyaratna); 033-2337-3846 (Kanyashree portal support, Women & Child Development Department); her school's Head or the Kanyashree cell at the DM office

A one-time grant of Rs.25,000 from the West Bengal government for the first marriage of an adult woman from a poor family. The money goes straight into the bride's own bank account before the wedding date. You fill a free paper form at your block, sub-division or municipal corporation office about one to two months before the wedding; officers then visit your area to check, and the BDO, SDO or Commissioner sanctions it. The new state government kept the scheme in 2026 and added voter-list details to the form.
Rs.25,000 once, into the bride's bank account before the wedding
An active bank account in her name alone, able to receive Rs.25,000 at a time
Kalitala village, Kalitala GP, Raina-II, Purba Bardhaman, 713421
The BDO, SDO or Commissioner sanctions it, and the Rs.25,000 is sent to your bank account, normally at least 5 days before the wedding date. An SMS comes to your mobile.
The Rupashree desk at your BDO, SDO or Municipal Corporation office; 033-2337-3846 (Rupashree portal support, Women & Child Development Department); 181 (Women Helpline)
1800-102-8014 (WBSCC State Help Desk, toll-free); SCC Grievance app on Google Play for complaints
The official or help-desk staff taking your enrolment, for example at a camp or hospital desk, fills in their own details. If you are applying alone and unsure, call 1800-345-5384 before you submit.
If the hospital asks for money for a covered treatment, or you get stuck, call 1800-345-5384 (24 hours).
1800-345-5384 (State Health Agency West Bengal, 24x7, toll-free); 14555 (Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY call centre)
